suggested_solution: G-Helper Settings: Reduce Core Clock Limit to 2795MHz and raise Core Clock and Memory to 205/405 respectively for GPU undervolting.
ThrottleStop Settings: Limit PL1/PL2 to 50/65 and PROCHOT to 92C for CPU throttling.
GPU Tweaking: Use MSI Afterburner to adjust the GPU settings, such as reducing voltage to 787mV @ 1740MHz.
